rationale: Both Qian and Varshil have deep Microsoft backgrounds and complement each other well on the design–science spectrum: Qian brings senior design engineering expertise while Varshil brings applied ML research skills (reinforcement learning, NLP, computer vision). Their combined experience could be valuable for building products that require both thoughtful systems design and robust ML foundations.
intro_message: Qian Jiang, meet Varshil Gandhi — you both come from Microsoft and could explore how design engineering and applied ML research intersect, especially given Varshil's work in reinforcement learning and maritime safety systems.
